THE DOLOMITES

Four nights of larch gold, one base in Corvara

One base in Corvara, Alta Badia, between Cortina and Val Gardena. Day trips by rental car in peak larch colour, then a drive to Venice via Bolzano and Merano.

Day by day

Tue 12 OctArrivalNature
Arrive in Corvara and settle in.
  • Check into Alta Badia, centrally placed between Cortina and Val Gardena.
  • Easy evening walk to settle in.
Wed 13 OctNatureScenic
Cortina d'Ampezzo and the big lakes.
  • Tre Cime di Lavaredo MUST-SEE
  • Lago di Braies, the turquoise lake.
Thu 14 OctNatureScenic
Val Gardena: ridge views and high meadows.
  • Seceda cable car for the ridge-line view.
  • Alpe di Siusi, Europe's largest high-alpine meadow, larches turning gold.
Fri 15 OctScenicNature3h00 driving
Sella Ronda pass loop, then Val di Funes.
  • Pass loop: Gardena, Sella, Pordoi, Campolongo. About 2 to 3 hours driving on its own.
  • Val di Funes, the Odle peaks above Santa Maddalena. About 1 hour each way, if time allows.
Sat 16 OctTravelMarketFestival3h00 driving
Drive to Venice via Bolzano and Merano.
  • About 2.5 to 3 hours total driving, with a stop in between.
  • Merano Grape Festival likely Oct 16 to 17. Catch it on Saturday market day only.

Know before you go

  • Best-odds larch window starts here. Colour is still building through the stay.
  • Sellaronda-area lifts are thinning out for the season. Passes stay open unless snow comes early.

Festivals & Events

  • HIGH CONFIDENCEPeak larch colour, Oct 12 to 22. The stay lands right at the start.
  • HIGH CONFIDENCETörggelen season, in full swing throughout the stay.
  • LIKELYMerano Grape Festival, 3rd weekend of October, likely Oct 16 to 17. Saturday market day only.
